candidate.selection_reason: Configuration setting check -> bypasses authentication when requireAuthentication is false -> could allow unauthorized access
candidate.source_summary: settings.requireAuthentication configuration value (defaults to false), which controls whether authentication is required for non-admin paths
candidate.sink_summary: cb(true) callback that grants access without authentication, allowing request to proceed to next middleware
candidate.guard_summary: Path-based guards: static paths bypass auth; /admin paths always require auth; requireAuthentication setting controls auth for other paths

enclosing_conditions: Static path bypass check precedes this condition
candidate.context_summary: The authorize function is called in Express middleware flow. When requireAuthentication=false and path is not /admin, access is granted without authentication checks. This affects all non-admin application routes.
